title: Agent Return
description: What a sub-agent hands back to its parent. Sub-agents run in isolated context and return only this — never their working context. The parent reads the artifact if it needs the detail.

summary.description: The decision or finding. Budget-capped: see runtime/context-budget.yaml.

artifacts.description: Paths, not contents. The parent fetches what it actually needs.

escalated_to_model.description: Set when the agent handed up a model tier, with the trigger.

tokens_used.description: Feeds token-accounting. An agent that cannot report this cannot be optimised.

context_loaded_unused.description: Tokens placed in context and never referenced. Feeds context-bloat-analysis.
